gloss: to be inferior, to fall behind

definitions.gloss: to be inferior to, to be worse than
definitions.explanation: To be of lower quality or ability than something else.

examples.japanese: どちらも{劣|おと}らず{素晴|すば}らしい。

notes:
{劣|おと}る is an intransitive godan verb meaning to be inferior or fall short in comparison.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- No transitive pair

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{劣|おと}る: to be inferior to ~
- 〜に{劣|おと}らず: not inferior to ~, equally
- {勝|まさ}るとも{劣|おと}らない: at least as good as (lit: even if surpassing, not inferior)
- どちらも{劣|おと}らず: both equally (good)

ASPECT (ている):
{劣|おと}っている describes an ongoing state of being inferior.

OPPOSITE:
- {優|すぐ}れる: to excel, be superior
- {勝|まさ}る: to surpass, exceed

The negative form {劣|おと}らない is frequently used to express equality or comparable quality.
